Here's the draft, Dana. It comes from #inc-qfl-sev1, where the incident happened on 4 Nov 2025.

**DRAFT – Sev 1 recap: Quarrendon Freight Lines, Superior terminal dock schedule sync (4 Nov 2025)**

- **What broke:** The dock schedule sync at Superior got stuck at about 6:40 AM, Superior local time. Drivers were backing up at the guard shack by around 7:00 AM. Dana raised the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM.
- **Who found the cause:** Samir Patel (on-call) found it at 7:17 AM. It was a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
- **Recovery:**
  - Samir cleared the stuck jobs, and Superior got a partial sync at about 8:15 AM. Some inbound trailers were still duplicating at that point.
  - Samir deployed a hotfix and finished the replay script at 2:38 PM. After that, all Superior dock schedules were syncing cleanly in real time.
- **Resolved:** Dana declared it resolved at 2:44 PM, after Thea confirmed from the yard.

Notes before this goes to the exec call:
- The channel doesn't say which time zone the message times (7:02 AM and so on) are in. Please check them before quoting them to Thea.
- Samir first looked at a 4 Nov deployment as a possible cause. The channel never confirms it, so I left it out.
- You said you'd pick up the postmortem notes. I can't see them, so this recap doesn't include any root-cause detail beyond the webhook listener.

Tell me what to change. I haven't sent this anywhere outside this channel.
